text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Coverage minus nominal at every output level, 12 to 36 hour lead. Above 0: the quantile is too high; below 0: too low. Levels 0.001 to 0.005 and 0.995 to 0.999 are extrapolated or fitted, not stored.'
text.tspan: Coverage minus nominal at every output level, 12 to 36 hour lead. Above 0: the quantile is too high;
below 0: too low. Levels 0.001 to 0.005 and 0.995 to 0.999 are extrapolated or fitted, not stored.
